title: A Jin--Xin Relaxation Gradual Convergence Method for Conservation-Law PINNs
summary: The Jin--Xin relaxation of a nonlinear hyperbolic conservation law introduces a relaxation parameter that controls the width of the internal layer resolving a shock; the discontinuity of the limiting conservation law emerges only in the singular limit as this width vanishes. Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) use smooth network approximations and are therefore not well suited to this limit, while relaxation PINNs with a fixed parameter resolve only a single scale and cannot follow the multiscale transition toward the limiting solution.
